slides.title: Low-energy day? Stop looking at your to-do list. Use an energy menu.
The problem with to-do lists
slides.body: They assume every day is a high-energy day. On low days they turn into a list of reasons to feel bad.

slides.title: An energy menu instead
slides.body: Sort your chores by how much energy they take. On any day, you order from the menu that matches you.

slides.title: Zero-energy option
slides.body: Some days the menu is 'rest'. That counts. Resting today is how you have energy tomorrow.

slides.title: Rest is a chore too. It's the one that makes the others possible.
Get the full energy menus
slides.body: Low, medium and high energy menus for every room are in The Messy Brain Home Reset. Link in bio.
